# The Alive Lab — Project Generation Rules

> Shared recommendations v0.1 for starting and evolving projects that are legible to humans and AI agents. Reference, not universally adopted policy.

- [README](README.md): purpose, scope and navigation.
- [Project foundation rules](rules/project-foundation.md): type, structure, authority, provenance and state.
- [Human and agent discovery rules](rules/human-and-agent-discovery.md): README, AGENTS.md and llms.txt responsibilities.
- [Bootstrap guide](guides/bootstrap.md): starting from an empty repository.
- [Evolution guide](guides/evolution.md): reorganizing responsibly.
- [New-project checklist](checklists/new-project.md): verification.
- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): contributing to these rules.
- [Visualization Rules](https://github.com/the-alive-lab/visualization-rules): separate optional visual guidance.

Consumer projects decide adoption. Human authority and canonical local sources take precedence.
